name: PhxUI
options:
  bundleIdPrefix: local.phx
  deploymentTarget:
    iOS: "16.0"
settings:
  base:
    SWIFT_VERSION: "5.0"
    CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED: "NO"
targets:
  PhxUITests:
    type: bundle.ui-testing
    platform: iOS
    sources: [Tests]
    settings:
      base:
        PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IDENTIFIER: local.phx.PhxUITests
        GENERATE_INFOPLIST_FILE: YES
schemes:
  PhxUITests:
    build:
      targets:
        PhxUITests: all
    test:
      targets:
        - PhxUITests
EOF
cat > Tests/PhxTests.swift <<'EOF'
import XCTest

final class PhxTests: XCTestCase {
    func testSendStatusUpdate() throws {
        let app = XCUIApplication(bundleIdentifier: "im.vector.app")
        app.activate()
        sleep(2)

        let room = app.staticTexts["Project Phoenix"].firstMatch
        XCTAssertTrue(room.waitForExistence(timeout: 10), "room not found")
        room.tap()
        sleep(3)

        let composer = app.textViews.firstMatch.exists ? app.textViews.firstMatch : app.textFields.firstMatch
        XCTAssertTrue(composer.waitForExistence(timeout: 10), "composer not found")
        composer.tap()
        sleep(1)
        composer.typeText("status update")
        sleep(1)

        let send = app.buttons["Send"].firstMatch
        if send.waitForExistence(timeout: 5) {
            send.tap()
        } else {
            app.keyboards.buttons["return"].firstMatch.tap()
        }
        sleep(2)

        let shot = XCTAttachment(screenshot: XCUIScreen.main.screenshot())
        shot.lifetime = .keepAlways
        add(shot)
    }
}
EOF

import XCTest

final class PhxTests: XCTestCase {
    func testSendStatusUpdate() throws {
        let app = XCUIApplication(bundleIdentifier: "im.vector.app")
        app.activate()
        sleep(2)

        let room = app.staticTexts["Project Phoenix"].firstMatch
        XCTAssertTrue(room.waitForExistence(timeout: 10), "room not found")
        room.tap()
        sleep(3)

        let composer = app.textViews["GrowingTextView"].firstMatch
        XCTAssertTrue(composer.waitForExistence(timeout: 10), "composer not found")
        composer.tap()
        sleep(1)
        composer.typeText("status update")
        sleep(1)

        let sendCandidates = app.buttons.matching(NSPredicate(format: "label == 'Send' OR identifier == 'Send' OR label CONTAINS[c] 'send'"))
        XCTAssertTrue(sendCandidates.firstMatch.waitForExistence(timeout: 5), "send button not found")
        sendCandidates.firstMatch.tap()
        sleep(3)

        let shot = XCTAttachment(screenshot: XCUIScreen.main.screenshot())
        shot.lifetime = .keepAlways
        add(shot)
    }
}
EOF
